def: A place to stand upon; a locus standi; hence, a foundation orbasis for operations.
A genus of nut-bearing trees or shrubs including the chestnutand chinquapin.
A game in which the object is to toss a ring so that it willcatch upon an upright stick.
A genus (Utricularia) of aquatic or marshy plants, whichusually bear numerous vesicles in the divisions of the leaves. Theseserve as traps for minute animals. See Ascidium.
Recovery, as of anything lost, especially of the health orstrength.
Fond of flogging; as, a plagose master. [R.]

The practice of too frequently using the word I; hence, aspeaking or writing overmuch of one's self; self-exaltation; self-praise; the act or practice of magnifying one's self or paradingone's own doings. The word is also used in the sense of egoism.His excessive egotism, which filled all objects with himself.Hazlitt.
A collection of particles or bodies into one mass; a heap; anaggregation.
A piece of a fallen wall; a ruin. [Obs.] Burton.
